Matthews Feed & Grain
Experience the history
Matthews Feed & Grain is a full service feed and grain elevator located in East Central Indiana; specializing in nationally branded swine show feeds, swine and poultry toll milling, house branded nutrition and custom rations for multiple species.
Serving the Nation Since 1920
CASH BIDS
Matthews Feed and Grain is committed to offering competitive cash bids for corn and soybeans. Feel free to reach out to us if you have any questions or require additional bid options. We're here to assist you!
